signals.title: OpenAI y Cisco presentan Shirudo: un entorno de ejecución Linux de código abierto que permite a los agentes defender los sistemas sin tiempo de inactividad
signals.summary: OpenAI y Cisco lanzan Shirudo, un runtime eBPF de código abierto para Linux que permite a agentes de IA crear “escudos” que bloquean vulnerabilidades sin detener el sistema.
signals.title_orig: OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime
signals.summary_orig: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release, BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux. AI agents write signed "shields" that block exploit paths on running systems while teams test and roll out real patches. The post OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime appeared first on MarkTechPost .

signals.title_orig: Anthropic Expands Enterprise Safeguards for Detecting AI Misuse
signals.summary_orig: EFS helps zero-retention customers spot Claude misuse spread across many requests while keeping conversation data in their own cloud. The post Anthropic Expands Enterprise Safeguards for Detecting AI Misuse appeared first on SecurityWeek .
